tools.name: get_city_stats
tools.description: Aggregate Thai-venue figures for one UK city/area, or up to five side by side. Use for totals and density, not for named venues. Returns venue count split by type, venues per 100k residents, and hygiene figures - a mean FHRS rating with the number rated, or FHIS pass/improvement counts for Scotland.

tools.name: search_restaurants
tools.description: Lists named Thai venues in a city or area. Use when the user wants specific places rather than totals. Filters: business type, minimum FHRS rating (0-5, integers only). Returns name, address, postcode, rating, last inspection date and the total number of matches. Omitting city searches the whole UK

tools.name: find_nearby
tools.description: Thai venues within a straight-line radius of a UK postcode. Use when the user gives a postcode or a place rather than a city name. Returns venues with great-circle distance in miles, rating and address; road distance will always be longer than the figure returned. No delivery, booking or opening-hou

tools.name: get_uk_overview
tools.description: UK-wide totals for Thai venues in FSA data: venue count with the dine-in, takeaway and pub-kitchen split, number of city/area rows, mean FHRS rating with the number rated, and the date of the snapshot. Single dated snapshot - there is no trend, growth or market-size figure.

tools.name: rank_cities
tools.description: Order city/area rows by Thai venue count, mean FHRS rating or venues per 100k residents. Use for 'which city has the most or the best'.
